title: Recruiting parser error transparency
repairs: Treats resume parsing as a non-persistent POST operation.
Displays the authoritative Recruiting ATS API error instead of an ambiguous write-reconciliation warning.
Preserves reconciliation protection for all persistent writes.
Keeps candidate fields transient and cleared after every failed parse.
uatPrerequisites: Firebase secret OPSIQO_GEMINI_API_KEY must be available to the App Hosting backend.
An approved active RECRUITING_ATS_MODEL profile and RECRUITING_ATS prompt must exist when strict governed AI configuration is enabled.
